Author: Sojiroh
Name: Triple Triad Autopilot
Punchline: Every NPC card, collected for you.
Description: Collects every Triple Triad card NPCs can give you: pick the cards you are missing, and the plugin travels to each NPC, builds a deck for its rules, plays until your cards drop, registers them, and moves on. Based on Auto Triple Triad Grind by XeldarAlz.
